name: Comparison · our way versus others, with six implications
purpose: Contrast two ways of working in paired lists, then spell out six implications for the client with an icon tile each, beside a short narrative and a calm labelled handover metric (label, value, one line of context).

source_advisory_slots.note: Names what the box measures; always a handover outcome.

One line saying what the client owns once the value is reached.
